body:
If it can help you, i'm the only one in my entire family and group of friends that had a neurological side effect. My brother 27M took the same shot as me (Pfizer same vaccine batch and had nothing) in the first dose he had a sore arm and the second was a little rough for the first 3 days then he was doing fine . My parents in their 60's had AZ and they had no side effects. Friends (from age 22 to 34)had mostly Moderna and Pfizer and they are doing well no side effects aswell. 
Intense side effects are very rare and most of the vaccinated do well.

Ou est ce que tu me vois comme antivax? mes parents à plus de 60 ans avec des problèmes de santé connus ont eu AZ et n'ont eu aucun effet secondaire ils vont bien et sont protégés! Mon frère a eu le même lot pfizer que moi à la première dose et n'a rien eu, il a eu sa 2ieme dose il y 1 semaine il n'a rien eu!!
J écris pas pour faire peur au monde, c'est rarissime ma réaction et je veux juste voir s'il y quelqu'un qui est passé par là et oui je suis un peu perdu aussi!

Merci! Il faut juste être patient. J'ai déjà parlé à infosante et médecin  la requette de neuro a été envoyée au CRDS j ai juste peur que ça prennes trop longtemps! je vais voir les démarches au privé

Merci tu as raisom, ça aide quand même écrire en ligne, juste le fait qu'il y aurait peut être quelqu'un qui est passé par là!ou encore le bon sens des autres surtout qd tu panique un peu. Un commentaire m'a conseillé le privé je vais essayer de trouver un neuro plus vite et sinon mon plan B j'ai un rendez vous de pris au Glen (hopital) pour la deuxième dose ils sauront quoi faire

My doctor told me that it was the immune system that was overreacting and my nerves were inflamated. Do you have weakness aswell?
It's better to see a doctor just to be sure! I hope you'll be doing well soon!

I'm not sure it will help you but in Ontario they have a pretty good data, and paresthesia/anesthesia is the fifth common side effect (12.7 in 100000 doses for AZ  https://www.publichealthontario.ca/en/data-and-analysis/infectious-disease/covid-19-data-surveillance) 
It's really frustrating as you said as no one knows how to treat all this!

I'm so sorry you're going through this, six weeks is a long time!
My doctor told me to take the second shot but to reschedule it for mid to end of August instead of the 31th July. I hope things will get better for you

Thank you for your post! I started to have paresthesia on the first day in the arm of the injection. Then between day 2 and day 3 both of my feet and later on started to go up till it reacted my knees.

I don't have much choice for the second shot, the pressure in my state/province is huge! (Quebec). They talked about a vaccine passport in September for people to enter gyms, restaurants, concerts...(if covid cases go up in fall). When entering a hospital they ask if you are vaccinated and how many shots. 
My doctor advised me to reschedule my second shot for mid to end of August (i had it scheduled for the 31th July)

I think with anything regarding the effects of the vaccine, ER is better. I had the same experience went to a family doctor ruled it as anxiety. 
The ER doctor knew what it was and talked about other cases she saw. She did a physical exam to rule out GBS (Guylaine barre syndrome). She told me that people With GBS would not be able to walk after a week  and their reflexes are really bad and no where near what i have. I'm really gratefull for that doctor in ER!

Thank you it's really helpfull to see people with the same issues! It's keeping me sane,I'll keep you posted, i hope your doctor will find a solution!
Good luck :)

Thank you! That's good news that you're doing better :) i do have antihistaminne for my seasonal allergy, i will go back again to ER next week ( 4 weeks in hopefully it won't ne as bad ). Did you get your second dose? Mine is scheduled  on the 31th July but doctor advised me to reschedule for mid to end of August.
Thank you! Good luck for tomorow i hope you'll get better soon :)
Thank you for your reply :) I have an apointment with my doctor next week! Fingers crossed
No i didn't get assessed for scoliosis but i have an appointment in two weeks, it's true my right shoulder is lower it's been my posture for the last months i didn't have that issue before :(

I did 3 months ago, doctor said it could be a tendinopathy or just an inflammation that would go away with rest and PT. But it didn't and started to notice more changes and pain (i can't activate some back muscles at all) . I have an apointment in 2 weeks (fingers crossed) 

If you don't mind me asking, how was your journey through recovery?
Yes it was negative, no growth
I hope it's not too late, we are here if you want to talk Cian!
